newsitem.title: UK: BOC up as three brokerages rate "buy".
newsitem.headline: BOC up as three brokerages rate "buy".

text.p: Shares in Britain's BOC Group rose on Wednesday after three influential brokerages made positive comments about the stock following an meeting with senior executives of the company, dealers said.
At 1013 GMT, the shares were up 11p to 902-1/2p.
The company hosted a dinner for City analysts last night.
SBC Warburg, Kleinwort Benson and Merrill Lynch reiterated their positive stances on the stock after last night's meeting.

"Senior management gave off positive sounds," said Kleinwort Benson analyst Michael Eastwood, who attended the dinner. He said the company was particularly upbeat about the potential for its industrial gases unit.
